items.title: The October inflection point for vibe game development
items.summary:

I think we've reached a new inflection point in October 2026, and this time it's for vibe coding computer games.

items.summary: Anthropic's full S1 is out, and it shows a business scaling faster than almost anything before it: $16.3B in first-half revenue, a first profitable quarter, and $132B in the bank. items.title: Quoting Terk Terkowitz
items.summary:
If your work does not benefit from current AI tooling, that is a finding, not a failing. Document why, share it with your community of peers, bring it to your manager, and work to find solutions. An engineer who can explain where AI does not yet help their work is demonstrating the judgement we are asking for.
— Terk Terkowitz, An update from Amazon engineering leadership on the role of the developer in the age of AI
